summary: You may still be organizing your life around preventing something that is no longer happening.
body: You may still be organizing your life around preventing something that is no longer happening. When Uranus sextiles Chiron, a changed schedule, different route, new tool, or one small exception can expose how much effort goes into avoiding an old problem. You skip the event, double-check the plan, keep the backup, or say no before anyone has the chance to disappoint you. Then you try it differently and nothing happens. Keep that information. A rule that once protected you does not deserve lifetime authority just because it was useful once.
